extracted.intended_audience: news organizations, digital platforms/distributors, journalists, funders, and policymakers concerned with media trust and newsworthiness
extracted.subtask_description: A set of principles and recommended practices for news organizations and distributors to build trust, assess newsworthiness, and guide production/distribution decisions. Covers transparency, disclosure, originality, inclusivity, audience engagement, and platform responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in development
rubrics_metrics.description: Make visible how a story was reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain editorial choices about why a story was done and its scope.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Why this story, what's the scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in correction
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledge and communicate mistakes openly and clearly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Clearly disclose who runs the organization and its ownership/leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Make funding sources and financial relationships transparent to audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of mission/values
rubrics_metrics.description: State the organization’s mission and core editorial values for audience awareness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original reporting valued over aggregation
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritize original reporting and new reporting efforts rather than relying primarily on aggregation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive reporting of diverse communities
rubrics_metrics.description: Report inclusively across diverse communities, ensuring coverage reflects and engages varied populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience engagement as core practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Center audience engagement as a fundamental newsroom practice to build accountability and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local presence as quality marker
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain or cultivate a local presence as an indicator of reporting quality and connection to community needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsible determination of what surfaces (for distributors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Distributors/platforms should take responsibility for how content is selected and surfaced to users.

rubrics_metrics.name: Algorithm transparency (for distributors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide transparency into algorithms that determine content distribution and ranking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality signals over engagement-only signals (for distributors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Favor quality-based signals rather than optimizing solely for engagement metrics when ranking or recommending news.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combat misinformation actively (for distributors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Take active measures to detect, limit, and correct misinformation on platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote authentic local news (for distributors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Support and surface authentic local news sources to strengthen local information ecosystems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trust-building practices as story criterion
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate stories by whether they incorporate practices that build audience trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency about process
rubrics_metrics.description: Make reporting processes and decision-making transparent as part of assessing story quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusivity of who/what is covered
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess newsworthiness by whether coverage includes diverse people, perspectives, and issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality vs. aggregation
rubrics_metrics.description: Prefer original reporting and new journalistic work over repeated aggregation when judging value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local presence as quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Treat local reporting capacity and presence as an evaluative marker of news quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public service mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Uphold journalism’s public service mission as a standard for editorial priorities and evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verifiability
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure facts and claims in reporting can be verified and sources are checkable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: Adhere to ethical standards in reporting, sourcing, correction, and disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain mechanisms for accountability to audiences, including engagement, corrections, and transparency.
